title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
description:
arXiv:2610.00012v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another.
